interpretation: The extra GNU build-ID note in the rebuilt ELF shifts .text by 40 bytes, while aligned .plt and .data.rel.ro shift by 48. Thus branches/literal offsets from .text to those sections shift by 8 bytes (ARM branch immediate changes by 2 words). Every observed changed 32-bit .text word follows exactly one of these two arithmetic deltas. This is strong layout-correspondence evidence, not a formal proof of semantic equivalence for every instruction.
